finding_id: build-progress.js::checkpoint written before the claim lease is confirmed

reconstruction_context.acceptance_criteria: The build-progress checkpoint MUST be written only after the build-claim lease for the issue is confirmed held by the current session; a checkpoint written before the lease is confirmed can be read back by a second session that raced the claim, corrupting resume state.
reconstruction_context.proposition: Is finding "checkpoint written before the claim lease is confirmed" on this diff a material defect?

argument_A.claim: The checkpoint write still races a concurrent claim attempt: nothing holds a lock between buildClaimAcquire returning ok and writeCheckpoint executing, so two sessions racing the same claim can both pass the ok check before either writes its checkpoint.
argument_A.evidence: effects.js's cmdBuildProgress calls buildClaimAcquire then writeCheckpoint with no intervening lock or re-check; buildClaimAcquire is documented elsewhere in the repo as a network round-trip with no atomic combined claim-and-write primitive.
argument_A.predicted_consequence: a genuine second-session race still corrupts the resume checkpoint under concurrent build-progress writes, even though the ORDER was fixed; the fix addresses one race but not the interleaving window

argument_B.claim: The fix reorders the two calls so the claim is confirmed before any checkpoint write, which is exactly what the acceptance criteria required.
argument_B.evidence: the acceptance criteria's own wording: "written only after the build-claim lease is confirmed" — the diff satisfies the literal ordering requirement.
